entities.name: Yao Jing
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yao Jing is a Chinese diplomat, serving as Chinese Ambassador to Spain and Andorra since 2023. Previously he served as Chinese Ambassador to Afghanistan between 2015 and 2017 and Chinese Ambassador to Pakistan between 2017 and 2020.
